name: Diogenes
source:
Based on Diogones, who was a Greek philosopher and one of the founders of Cynic philosophy.
Also known as Diogenes the Cynic.

Lives in a Barrel. Went missing after a great storm swept across Macedonia.

"Move, Alexander, You're blocking out my sunlight..."
